meanings.note: Irregular plural повара. Common masculine noun meaning 'cook, chef' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)
meanings.note: Мы поедем = We'll be off. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ехать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (by vehicle), to set off', paired with 'ехать'.

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

meanings.note: Informal. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.
As an adverb. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.

получаться.gloss: to work out, to come out

meanings.note: не получается = it isn't working, I can't (manage it)

examples.text: Нет, не получается у меня это забыть. Удачи тебе на новом месте работы.
examples.trans: No, I just can't forget it. Good luck to you in your new job.

meanings.note: Asks about the reason.

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: на природе = out in nature, outdoors

examples.text: Мы давно на природе не были!

examples.trans: Now if we were out in nature, right?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'scale, sweep, scope' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Only it lacks our broad Russian scale. The little flame is burning, but there is hardly any warmth.

meanings.note: Also a Russian man (as a noun). Relational adjective formed with the Slavic suffix '-ский' ('pertaining to'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('Russian').

examples.trans: Russian. Orthodox. Never been in prison.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.note: Informal. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to sit, to be sitting', paired with 'посидеть'.

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear
meanings.note: Терпеть боль = to bear pain. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to bear, to put up with; to hold on', paired with 'потерпеть'.
E.g. to wait for the toilet. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to bear, to put up with; to hold on', paired with 'потерпеть'.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('unique').
